historical_record.description: Kezar Stadium and Pavilion went up at the park's southeast corner on Stanyan Street, on a site chosen after plans to complete the Golden Gate Park Stadium at the Polo Field were abandoned.
The Works Progress Administration replaced Kezar Stadium's wooden seating with concrete seating for 60,000 spectators.
